import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Clean Category: strip whitespace and standardize
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip()
    
    # Clean Price: remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
    df['Price'] = df['Price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[^0-9.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)
    
    # Clean Region: standardize case to title case
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    return df['Category'].value_counts().to_dict()
